title: foreach_union_repeat_json
description: Finding 3 (PR #34): a direct `forEach` over a field that a sibling `unionAll`'s `repeat` forces to raw JSON[] must read it through the from_json bridge (jsonMode), like `emitScope` already does for a field its OWN sibling `repeat` forces. Before the fix `jsonMode` was derived from this scope's own repeat children only, so the forEach read the forced-JSON field as a typed struct and returned JSON-quoted values. Distinct values so the order-independent Set comparison cannot mask the quoting.

tests.title: forEach beside a unionAll repeat over the same field returns typed values
tests.description: Root forks on a direct forEach:item (reading linkId) and a unionAll whose only branch is repeat:[item]. The unionAll forces `item` to JSON[]; the direct forEach must be bridged so linkId is the typed string g1/g2, not the JSON-quoted "g1"/"g2".
